SHOW CAUSE NOTICE UNDER SECTION 73 OF THE CGST ACT 2017
Notice Ref: SCN/MH/2023/101 Dated 15-10-2023
GSTIN: 27AAACA1234A1Z5 M/s Acme Traders Pvt Ltd
FY: 2023-24

1. On examination of GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B filings for FY 2023-24, it is observed that Input Tax Credit of Rs. 2,50,000/- claimed in GSTR-3B exceeds GSTR-2A auto-populated reflection by Rs. 1,00,000/-.
2. You are hereby called upon to show cause why the differential ITC of Rs. 1,00,000/- along with interest under Section 50 should not be demanded under Section 73(1).
